product_overview: Deelrx is a unified multi-tenant platform designed for regulated, inventory-driven retail businesses. It delivers a privacy-first, fast POS experience on web and mobile, with granular owner-configurable privacy and security settings, full control over inventory, credit, sales, and compliance management, enabling businesses ranging from open CRM to secure alias-only operations.
core_goals: Deliver blazing-fast, accurate, privacy-first POS across mobile and web platforms.
Ensure strict multi-tenant isolation with no cross-tenant data or content leakage.
Provide granular, owner-configurable privacy, security, and compliance controls including GDPR, HIPAA, and SOC 2 standards.
Offer comprehensive business control over inventory, credit management, sales tracking, auditing, and product aliasing.
Enable configurable workflows and permissions for roles including Owner, Manager, and Staff/Cashier.
Implement a highly guided onboarding flow capturing all critical business data and preferences.
Support secure, auditable inventory intake and adjustments with full multi-unit conversions and audit logging.
key_features: Multi-tenant architecture with strict tenant isolation and scoped user access.
Owner-configurable privacy presets ranging from Open to Max Secure including failsafe mechanisms.
Detailed onboarding flow capturing business name, contact, units, privacy settings, user roles, product aliases, and optional legal information.
Inventory management supporting multi-unit intake and adjustments with batch processing and audit trails.
Sales tracking system integrated with real-time compliance enforcement.
Credit management with policies and API endpoints.
Role-based admin panel for managing users, features, permissions, and audit logs.
Advanced privacy and compliance layer supporting GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS readiness.
AI-powered insights for enhanced operational intelligence.
POS settings including barcode enablement, haptic feedback, and offline mode.
user_flow_summary: Owner/Manager completes business onboarding capturing all required tenant-specific data before any transactions.
Owners configure privacy presets, user roles, intake/adjustment reasons, credit policies, and POS settings.
Staff performs inventory intake or adjustments via mobile or web with real-time validation and audit logging.
Sales transactions are processed through a responsive POS interface with compliance gating.
Admins manage user roles, permissions, and monitor audit logs to ensure security and compliance.
Batch inventory intake via CSV import for efficient multi-item processing with audit integrity.
Users authenticate via secure flows including login, registration, and onboarding powered by Clerk and MFA.
validation_criteria: System enforces all required onboarding fields before allowing transactional use.
Only authorized roles (Owner, Manager) can assign roles, configure settings, and view audit logs.
All inventory intake and adjustment actions are logged with user details, timestamps, change deltas, and reasons.
Multi-tenant isolation is verified by pen testing ensuring no data leakage across tenants.
Performance benchmarks: mobile intake <10s and batch web intake <2s per 50 items are met.
Security compliance requirements such as TLS encryption, OWASP mitigation, GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, and PCI DSS are satisfied.
Automated tests cover ≥85% critical path including security and multi-tenancy validations.
User data deletion requests are handled correctly per privacy presets and compliance mandates.
